g.text: Register handoff: a thread's 32 accumulator values become 4 A fragments of 8
thread t: r = floor((t mod 32)/4) + 16w, c = t mod 4; C value (v0, v1, v2) is at row r + 8 v1, column 8 v2 + 2c + v0
in each 2x2 block: top row v1 = 0 (row r), bottom row v1 = 1 (row r + 8); left v0 = 0, right v0 = 1
acc_qk fragment (FP32, C layout), grouped by v2 = 8-column group:
tOrP (BF16, A layout): 4 K blocks of 16 columns, 8 values each = shape (8, MMA_M = 1, MMA_K = 4)
convert_c_layout_to_a_layout(c, a) builds the layout (a, c.shape[1], (c.shape[2], size(c, mode 0) / size(a)))
with the K-block stride equal to size(a, mode 2) times c's v2 stride, so K block kb takes the C groups
v2 = 2kb and 2kb + 1 in register order. make_acc_into_op allocates the 8 x 1 x 4 tensor, aliases it under
the C layout, and does one load, one cast to BF16, one store. No lane exchanges data in the BF16 case.
Eight values per K block matches the PTX A fragment for m64nNk16: four .f16x2 registers per thread.
